name: clipfacil
description: Editor de vídeo por opções — local, gratuito, sem IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@clipfacil/pipeline && npm run build --workspace=@clipfacil/api && npm run build --workspace=@clipfacil/web
